methods: Mixed lives: equal weights at 64, 128 and 256 contacts, each metric paired by world and training birth. Both signed histories of the same world stay together; worlds are nested within birth. Natural quiz uses the interval ending at each age. Conflict probes are included only after all three types were actually observed, just as in the source. Local slow rates: 16, 64 and 128 contacts, initially four A/B reviews and no further A. The local experiment has shared geometries crossed with training birth; all laws stay paired. All intervals are pointwise.
